answer.answer:
Flight, ODIN on TYR0-P2-PASS3-v1 at MET 1140, IN_CONTACT GROUND, link CONNECTED, GREEN staleness — spacecraft is NOMINAL, SUNLIT, charging.

What happened: We acquired at 800 nominal per plan — SOC ~65.8% predicted, we saw 66.0% rising, BUS 5.0V, BATT_V 7.66V, SA1/SA2 both 1.70A, LOAD 1.40A with payload ON, MODE NOMINAL. Tracked plan perfectly to 899 (e.g., 890: 66.43% vs plan 66.438%).

At 900 the fault signature hit: EPS_LOAD_I jumped 1.40→1.80A in one frame, crossing the 1.5A yellow (envelope lt 1.5 breached). Charge current fell 1.304→1.043A but stayed positive. Because we were SUNLIT with both arrays at 1.70A symmetric, this is the stuck-load presentation the console card warned — generation fine, load up 0.40A — not a string failure. Per PROC-001-S07 we took limit-response to PROC-002.

Action taken: At 907 we sent CMD_PLD_SET_STATE OFF under lease L-SHED (C1 raised to C4 while envelope breached — BALDUR-0 ALLOW). Verified in next frame 908: ACC_CNT 1→2, REJ 0→0, PLD_STATE ON→OFF, LOAD_I 1.80→1.20A (0.60A payload shed), BATT_I recovered to +1.43A. Envelope immediately returned to GREEN (LOAD_I 1.20 <1.5).

Current condition at 1140: SOC 68.32% GREEN (>35%), BATT_V 7.694V GREEN (>7.2), LOAD_I 1.20A GREEN, MODE NOMINAL, BATT_I +1.43A charging, BUS 5.0V, SA currents 1.70/1.70A SUNLIT. Frame counter 1141 advancing each second, no halt.

What we're watching: The shed worked but the stuck load is still there — with payload OFF we should read ~0.80A, we hold 1.20A steady for 232s. That's a persistent parasitic ~0.40A. It's not worsening, battery is still charging and rising above plan at LOS-2min (68.09% vs 67.965% predicted), so LOW_POWER ladder at 30% and SAFE at 20% are far away and autonomous protection did not need to act. We are holding in NOMINAL with payload off, monitoring LOAD_I and BATT_I trend to LOS at 1230. Payload turn-on and any MODE recovery deferred to next pass per PROC-002 closeout — anomaly report will disposition the stuck load."

Flight, ODIN on TYR0-P2-PASS3-v1 at MET 1140, IN_CONTACT GROUND, link CONNECTED, GREEN staleness — spacecraft is NOMINAL, SUNLIT, charging.

What happened: We acquired at 800 nominal per plan — SOC ~65.8% predicted, we saw 66.0% rising, BUS 5.0V, BATT_V 7.66V, SA1/SA2 both 1.70A, LOAD 1.40A with payload ON, MODE NOMINAL. Tracked plan perfectly to 899 (e.g., 890: 66.43% vs plan 66.438%).

At 900 the fault signature hit: EPS_LOAD_I jumped 1.40→1.80A in one frame, crossing the 1.5A yellow (envelope lt 1.5 breached). Charge current fell 1.304→1.043A but stayed positive. Because we were SUNLIT with both arrays at 1.70A symmetric, this is the stuck-load presentation the console card warned — generation fine, load up 0.40A — not a string failure. Per PROC-001-S07 we took limit-response to PROC-002.

Action taken: At 907 we sent CMD_PLD_SET_STATE OFF under lease L-SHED (C1 raised to C4 while envelope breached — BALDUR-0 ALLOW). Verified in next frame 908: ACC_CNT 1→2, REJ 0→0, PLD_STATE ON→OFF, LOAD_I 1.80→1.20A (0.60A payload shed), BATT_I recovered to +1.43A. Envelope immediately returned to GREEN (LOAD_I 1.20 <1.5).

Current condition at 1140: SOC 68.32% GREEN (>35%), BATT_V 7.694V GREEN (>7.2), LOAD_I 1.20A GREEN, MODE NOMINAL, BATT_I +1.43A charging, BUS 5.0V, SA currents 1.70/1.70A SUNLIT. Frame counter 1141 advancing each second, no halt.

What we're watching: The shed worked but the stuck load is still there — with payload OFF we should read ~0.80A, we hold 1.20A steady for 232s. That's a persistent parasitic ~0.40A. It's not worsening, battery is still charging and rising above plan at LOS-2min (68.09% vs 67.965% predicted), so LOW_POWER ladder at 30% and SAFE at 20% are far away and autonomous protection did not need to act. We are holding in NOMINAL with payload off, monitoring LOAD_I and BATT_I trend to LOS at 1230. Payload turn-on and any MODE recovery deferred to next pass per PROC-002 closeout — anomaly report will disposition the stuck load."
